E0930

marker arguments do not match the typed signature in the shared marker registry (D-MARKSIG1=A)

What

marker arguments do not match the typed signature in the shared marker registry (D-MARKSIG1=A)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0930

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0930: tests/ui/arithmetic_policy_invalid.stderr.

Error [E0930]: `#Arithmetic` has no `ArithmeticMode` called `Other`
  --> tests/ui/arithmetic_policy_invalid.jet:1:2
    |
  1 | #Arithmetic(.Other) fn bad() {}
    |  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `ArithmeticMode` is a closed menu: `Checked`, `Wrapping`, `Saturating`
 Fix: pick one of `Checked`, `Wrapping`, `Saturating`
